input: I'm sure his dad had power of attorney, so look at him first. He's a rat.

Meanwhile I offered to buy a used car for my parents for about 1k and they insisted it be a loan and paid me back, so I set it at £10 a week and even then kept telling them don't worry.
I bought them a new cooker a few years back as their previous one was over 20 years old and my mum was in tears telling me I didn't need to buy them anything.
I offered to buy a new bed for them too, it was only a few years old but cheap and it was causing back pain and they declined.

Some people are saying it was an early stoppage, which I don’t think it was at all, but even if it was I think it’s pretty obvious that the ref saved Benn from a brutal KO that was going to happen sooner than later. He had nothing for Garcia and stopped throwing.
